content:
Mira: Heads-up — ran sensitivity sims for Nov–Jan surge with current booking and H100/H200/L40S mixes. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/surge-sims
Sam: Nice, what's the baseline assumptions?
Mira: baseline = 3% weekly growth, peak daily qps 2.2M tokens, 70% gen load. config:
```
window: 90d
baseline_growth: 0.03
peak_factor: 2.1
models: {h100:0.4, h200:0.4, l40s:0.2}
```
Tony: lead times: H200 18-24w, H100 8-12w, L40S 6-10w. procurement needs PO by 2049130000 to hit Dec deliveries.
Evan: network egress constraints in eu-west1 still hit on sustained bursts; we need headroom in us-east.
Katie: can we route overflow to Dedicated burst pool? That costs ~1.8x but reduces tail latency.
Mira: sims show with +20% unexpected demand we exhaust H200 hours by mid-December; fallback to L40S raises p90 latency from 120ms -> 220ms.
Sam: show numbers
Mira: quick table:
```
scenario | h100hrs | h200hrs | l40shrs | est_cost
base     | 120k    | 140k    | 40k     | $1.2M
+20%     | 125k    | 170k    | 60k     | $1.5M
+35%     | 140k    | 190k    | 90k     | $1.9M
```
Tony: can we shift some reserved spend to H100? vendor says limited H100 stock in Q4. H100 are cheaper per-token on current runtime.
Evan: networking: need to prebook cross-region bandwidth or we'll see 15% increase in tail latency during bursts. estimate $18k/month for reserves.
Katie: ops ask: suggest phased reservation: commit to H200 baseline + flex H100 credits + L40S spot pool.
Mira: Proposed ask: PO for 120 H200 slots (12mo) + 200 H100 credits (6mo) + 300 L40S spot units. @Tony please confirm vendor next steps.
Procurement Bot: flagged: vendor A needs LOI by 2049132000; vendor B has 6w faster lead time but +8% unit cost.
Tony: I'll take vendor convo. If vendor B gets us in time, prefer that for Q4.
Sam: Quick question — any chance to squeeze more KV cache reuse to reduce GPU-hours? Marco's caching PR lands later this week.
Mira: yes, caching reduces peak GPU-hours ~8% in sims when hit rate >40%. Add that to recommendation.
Evan: I'll open a ticket to reserve cross-region BW and configure routing policies for overflow to us-east.
Katie: LGTM — let's lock PO draft and run tabletop escalation drill for a 30% surge scenario next week. :thumbsup:
Tony: on it. ETA PO draft EOD tomorrow.
Mira: thanks all. I'll update the sheet with vendor timelines and final ask.
